verifiedSound: Pure SHA-256 matched node:crypto on 711 boundary inputs including padding boundaries, multibyte text, lone surrogates and about 1 MiB inputs
File size, text length, UTF-8 length and bracket depth are bounded before JSON.parse; later walks are capped
Plain-data readers never invoke accessors; prototype-shaped keys stay data
Exact canonical spelling and checksum reject whitespace, duplicate or reordered keys and rounded numbers
Portable rows have exactly the documented keys; derived, pending and lastCompletion cannot be supplied
One readwrite transaction checks epoch, receipts, emptiness and capacity before writing; success only on completion
Readback is separate and exact; probe and readback never create storage
Staging only adds pending, so exporting without it yields the last settled state
